description.value:
Gunslinger Practice operatives have made an art of the trick shot, treating every duel as a chance to show off just how much can be done with a blaster and steady nerves. They read an opponent's stance and habits the way others read a datapad, spotting the one opening a normal shot would miss.

Confidence is as much their weapon as their sidearm, a Gunslinger strolls into danger expecting to walk out again, and usually does, leaving foes stunned by shots that shouldn't have been possible.
